required: exact selected ToolSelectionPlan id and digest
entity, period, form, source-policy and authority filters

topk_resolution_contract.source_of_request: EvidenceRequest.topk_policy is an input to resolution, never a global constant or agent-controlled free parameter.
topk_resolution_contract.lowering_rule: An explicitly versioned source-type/evidence-role profile may lower a quantity; the resolver must record that profile and reason. It may not raise a value, and an agent may not choose a larger value.
topk_resolution_contract.raising_rule: Any future increase requires an explicit approved profile/version/authority and remains bounded by the hard maxima; no current execution route is authorized to perform it.
topk_resolution_contract.capacity_rule: If exact EvidenceRequest.topk_policy cannot support the selected profile, resolution emits topk_policy_capacity_insufficient or topk_policy_rejected rather than silently clamping upward.

reranker_profile_contract.future_model_profile_boundary: A model reranker must have a separate profile id/version, model-resource authority, budget, package approval and execution route. It cannot share the deterministic baseline route or be introduced by configuration alone.

no_second_state_model.rule: The above are immutable in-memory projections. Future M6.3R execution may emit the existing canonical_runtime.CandidateBundle only; it may not introduce a retrieval database, context store, evidence table, approval registry or writer-facing object.

pipeline: validate exact request/plan/adapter snapshot lineage and resolve the request-bound TopKPolicy
metadata-first filter by entity, period, form, source policy, source family, authority and immutable snapshot
bounded local recall to resolved candidate_bundle_top_k
deterministic zero-model rerank to resolved rerank_top_k
source-diversity selection to the separately named evidence_gate_candidate_top_k (at most five)
same-document neighbor/section/table/page/row expansion under fixed caps
produce existing CandidateBundle-compatible nonpersistent projection or a typed retrieval_exhausted result

diversity_and_ties.single_source_exception: If fewer than two eligible source families exist after metadata filtering, retain the bounded single-source result and emit typed code diversity_not_applicable_single_source.
diversity_and_ties.duplicate_rule: Same source artifact and identical content digest cannot silently occupy more than their caps. Excluded rows retain deterministic exclusion reasons in the ephemeral audit projection.

neighbor_expansion.coordinate_lineage_rule: Every expanded reference must retain document, parser, source artifact, index-or-graph coordinate and adapter snapshot digest. Missing coordinates are excluded rather than inferred.
stop_rules: stop when a requested neighbor is absent, cross-document, stale, unversioned or authority-incompatible
stop after one deterministic lookup per permitted relation; no recursive expansion
stop without external repair, retry, fallback or synthetic coordinate

typed_exhaustion.prohibition: Typed exhaustion never invokes SourceHunter, network, fallback retrieval, parser, numeric normalization, Evidence Gate or Writer.

future_execution_points.scope: typed schemas, request-bound TopK resolver and injected read-only adapter seams; no local index, graph, SQL or tool read
sanitized immutable candidate/neighbor/SQL-row fixtures and deterministic diversity, TopK and exhaustion tests

bounded local read-only BM25/ObjectBM25/graph execution plus a bounded exact-value ledger SQL lane. The SQL lane requires a pinned immutable ledger snapshot, M6.2 ToolRegistry/ToolInvocationReceipt admission, exact entity/period/unit/form/source-tier/lineage validation, no relaxed-filter fallback and no promotion.
slot-level precision/recall, diversity, SQL false-positive, expansion-stop and typed-exhaustion corpus calibration

calibration_corpus_plan.unit_of_eval: EvidenceRequest slot with versioned gold candidate ids and eligible-neighbor coordinates
negative_cases: SQL row without unit or source tier
no candidate must not trigger fallback

prohibited_execution: provider, embedding, reranker model or paid model
business Case mutation or legacy authority change
